title: indigo_mount_simulator: MOUNT_STATE slew light never shows a coordinates ALERT
description: Audit in 1078b2c4: the slew light is never set to ALERT. mount_simulator ships with INDIGO and is user-visible. Owner's rule (decided 2026-11-22 for mount_synscan, ticket 1078b2c4, and extended to this driver on 2026-11-23): whenever MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES is in ALERT, the SLEW light of MOUNT_STATE is ALERT too; BUSY while the coordinates are BUSY; otherwise as before. The library keeps a coordinates ALERT until the next BUSY (indigo_update_coordinates() kept-ALERT rule, indigo_reject_coordinates_change()), so the light must be derived from the coordinates state after indigo_update_coordinates() has decided it, at every place the driver publishes the coordinates or MOUNT_STATE (poll, refusals, sync, abort, park/home, connect), not from the driver's own motion flags alone. Reference implementation: synscan_update_mount_state() and its call order in indigo_drivers/mount_synscan/indigo_mount_synscan.driver (commit 5f794cc15). Scope: the .driver source (version bump, regenerate with the unchanged generator), simulator-backed cases proving the light follows the coordinates state through a refused/failed request (ALERT kept while idle), the next accepted request (BUSY, then OK/IDLE) and connect, adaptation of existing cases that asserted IDLE under a kept ALERT, recorded run with tools/run_driver_test.py, MIGRATION_STATUS count. Refusals inserted by the generator (parked/homing guards) cannot call driver code; if the light lags there until the next poll, record it in the ticket note and do not change the generator.
